questions.stem: Which of the following statements about the spaces of the larynx is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The paraglottic space is located above the infrahyoid epiglottis.

options.label: B
options.text: The preepiglottic space is continuous with the paraglottic space.

options.label: C
options.text: Reinke's space is located between the quadrangular membrane and the thyroid cartilage.

options.label: D
options.text: Tumours in the preepiglottic space typically extend into the neck via the cricothyroid membrane.
